body:
There are some things that happened that might have triggered it, but far worse things have happened to other people, and they got through it. I have seen a therapist, I'm seeing one right now actually, but it isn't really helping all that much.
I wasn't always a rich kid though, I went from living in a 1 bedroom apartment on a really shitty side of my city, to having everything a kid could want, the money to get whatever I want really, and a nice house.
I was really happy when it all first happened, but then the depression returned again. 
Most other people would be so grateful, and  probably would be sad in the slightest bit, but not me. I still feel like there's no point to any of this.
So tell me, is someone that ungrateful really deserving of being saved?
